name: Bash
description: Executes a given shell command via busybox sh and returns stdout/stderr. Use for running programs, pipelines, and anything not covered by the other tools. Output is truncated at 128KB.

name: Read
description: Read a file from the local filesystem using the busybox cat applet (direct in-process call, no exec).

path.description: Path to the file to read (absolute or relative to cwd)

name: Grep
description: Search file contents with the busybox grep applet (direct in-process call). Returns matching lines with line numbers. If path is omitted, searches the current directory recursively.

path.description: File or directory to search (default: cwd, recursive)
